description: This PHP class represents the entity 'BuzzLikeOnShare' in a Doctrine ORM context, modeling a 'like' on a social media share within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains properties for ID, associated share, employee who liked it, and timestamp, along with getter and setter methods.
published: Odds of requiring external systems: high (due to ORM annotations and associated entity references)

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Represents a 'like' action on a shared post in a social feature, with properties for the ID, share, employee, and timestamp, including ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the shared BuzzShare entity associated with this like.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Sets the BuzzShare entity associated with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the like was made to the current UTC time.
